name: supabase_table_query
description: Query and insert rows in a Supabase Postgres table using @supabase/supabase-js. Supports column selection, filtering, ordering, and pagination.

action.description: Action to perform: 'query' to read rows or 'insert' to add a row

table.description: Name of the Supabase table to query or insert into

columns.description: Comma-separated column names to select (default '*' for all columns)

filters.description: Array of filter objects with column, operator (eq, neq, gt, gte, lt, lte, like, ilike, in), and value

order_by.description: Column name to order results by

ascending.description: Sort order: true for ascending, false for descending (default true)

limit.description: Maximum number of rows to return (1-1000, default 50)

offset.description: Number of rows to skip for pagination (default 0)

row.description: Row data to insert (required when action is 'insert')
